PreToolUse.description: Remind naming conventions + enforce ontology Action preconditions (cross-platform via node; scripts early-exit on non global_ontology/entities/ global_ontology/relations/ paths)

OCR MCP guard: detects direct paddleOCR-mcp calls and reminds to use document-parsing skill. On Windows/PowerShell, shell-level pre-filter has encoding issues with JSON pipes, so node is spawned for every MCP call (~50ms overhead). The guard function early-exits for non-OCR calls after a quick stdin check. Claude Code uses a bash pre-filter (mcp-ocr-guard.sh) to avoid this overhead.
